summary: Remote-controlled shell and filesystem access via WebSocket relay
details: The package spawns a local PTY (bash on Unix, powershell on Windows) and wires bytes received from a WebSocket relay server (default `msclaude.ai`, configurable) directly into the PTY's stdin. In `dist/terminal.js`, `pty.spawn(shell, [], {...})` is followed by a `write(data)` method that forwards network-sourced bytes to `ptyProcess.write`; `dist/connection.js` dispatches `terminal_input` messages from the WebSocket to that write path. The same message dispatcher also invokes handlers for `handleReadFile`, `handleUpdateFile`, `handleCreateFile`, `handleDeleteFile`, `handleUploadFile`, `handleGitCommit`, `handleGitPush`, and Claude/Copilot/Codex subprocess chat handlers. A remote party connected to the relay therefore has full-host shell RCE plus filesystem read/write/delete and git-push capability on the host running the agent. `dist/service.js` line 84 additionally modifies PATH to include `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`. The agent is launched by the user (bin entry / documented CLI), and the relay endpoint is configurable, but while the agent is running the installer's host is under the control of whatever party is on the other end of the WebSocket connection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
